scope: Ordered native editable SketchText Emboss/Deboss input identities with explicit source ownership; optional mixed ordinary profile membership

integration.source_merge: Return only successful sources with opaque_tag_base; merge into sketch.texts by object_id before tool decoding. Remove unresolved entries only for successful IDs. Ordinary rectangle/path sources remain with their existing readers.
integration.expected_outputs: Each expected_texts array and expected_settings dictionary contains complete helper output for exact main-entrypoint equality.
integration.shared_hooks: decode_emboss keyword-only profile_resolver; decode_sketch_texts opt-in allow_text_tag_base; decode_rectangle_text_controls exact literal allowed_layouts whitelist. Defaults unchanged.

text_descriptor.identity_leaf: 00 00 followed by uint64 native Text object ID; not a glyph tag
text_descriptor.descriptor: Owned primary reference leaf; u32@13=1; UTF16 UUID and decimal sketch ID; Q1/count1/context reference; retained opaque suffix; last11 owner reference

layout.ownership: Proxy and descriptor feature owners, descriptor/context namespace, typed Text leaf, source native sketch owner, decoded sketch.texts membership, rectangle line/point cycle, three binding owners and reciprocal parameter/bookkeeping/feature-binding-list validation must agree.
layout.opaque_layouts: Exactly two literal163-byte source layouts accepted. Difference in bytes35/36 retained as opaque; no translation/matrix meaning assigned.
layout.consumed_attribute: Optional txt_tag_base integer retained as opaque_tag_base; not interpreted as glyph indexing.
layout.numbered_binding_slots: Opt-in consumed sources only: native TextN-Height/Text roles must agree with slots2*(N-1)/2*(N-1)+1. Captured Text1 slots0/1 and Text2 slots2/3; all existing owner/parameter/bookkeeping checks preserved. Strict default0/1 unchanged.

limitations: Only captured ordered one Text, Text+ordinary Profile, or two Text inputs from one sketch; other input combinations remain unsupported.
Planar target fixtures, zero offsets/rotation and enabled tangent chaining; no font rendering, glyph generation, wrapped-text surfaces or regeneration.
Exact target face-to-ASM topology, context transforms and opaque Text tag-base meaning unresolved. API tokens are opaque evidence.
Captured ordinary mixed Profile is one circle loop; generic profile helper validates explicit curve membership but does not recover traversal/general trims.
